summary_bullets: Harden script issue-number boundaries with numeric self-validation before gh calls
Validate non-empty tracking sentinel ISSUE_NUMBER and RUN_ID values with fixed-token malformed-value errors
Add and wire offline regression coverage for the new validation contracts
commit_message:
Harden tracking issue input validation

Add numeric self-validation for issue-number argv at get-issue-state and tracking-issue-read boundaries. Validate non-empty sentinel ISSUE_NUMBER and RUN_ID values with fixed-token malformed-value errors, and cover the behavior with offline harnesses.
